text:
Maria R.: TL;DR: postmortem is up (https://redwood.internal/pm/INF-2345). proposing clear owners, a 3-week remediation cadence, and a recurring check-in for the KV-cache leak/oom pattern. please react with :thumbsup: if you can own parts.
Alex T.: ack. can take the profiling + heap-snapshot work this sprint.
Jamal S.: I can own GC tuning experiments and canary rollout.
Ingrid L.: I'll own alerting thresholds + runbook updates + the canary gating.
Patrick H.: Devex: I'll add ticket templates + cost impact calc to the postmortem.
sre-bot: Incident INF-2345 marked RESOLVED; follow-ups requested by Maria R.
Maria R.: Concrete ask: split into three streams -> (1) profiling & leak hunting, (2) GC/limits & runtime mitigations, (3) operational controls (alerts, runbooks, throttles). owners above map to those. propose checkpoints: EOW quick report, + 3-week slot for root-cause verification, + 90-day recurring watch.
Alex T.: first profiling note: reproducer runs show long-lived allocs in cache shards when pressure spikes. sample pmap snippet:
```
0000561a7c  mem  1.2G  rss  1.1G  size  64K   path /opt/redwood/runtime
```
noting: fragmentation grows when many small inserts happen after large seq-gen.
Jamal S.: ran a flamegraph on last incident vm; kv shard hot path shows a retained vector growth in `shard::insert_if_missing`. pushing a minimal repro PR.
Ingrid L.: Alerting: current OOM pager triggers when host free memory < 1.5GB. propose adding a KV-cache-specific soft alarm: if sum(kv_rss_pct) > 75% for 2 min -> create SEV2 and capture debug-snapshot automatically.
Maria R.: Agree. Also add auto-heap-snapshot upload to S3 on SEV2 so we can analyze without bouncing instances.
Patrick H.: Ops change request INF-2352 created to add snapshotter and preflight checks to canary.
Alex T.: Profiling plan (week 1): 1) add jemalloc stats export, 2) nightly heap-snapshots of canary, 3) instrument shard alloc counts. I'll open INF-2353 with details.
Jamal S.: GC experiments (week 2): try tuned tcmalloc/jemalloc param set and forced periodic compaction. If fragmentation delta > 15% after 24h, rollback. results to be posted in the ticket.
Ingrid L.: Runbook updates: add step-by-step for graceful cache eviction, minority shard drain, and safe reboot. also add quick commands for capturing `pmap` and `gdb -batch -ex \"info proc mappings\"` output.
Maria R.: Timeline: owners to post sprint plan by EOD Tue. weekly stand for 30 min Fridays for the next 3 weeks (first check-in Friday). if someone can't make it, post short notes in thread.
Alex T.: Question: do we want automated per-request KV TTL tuning? we could do adaptive TTL based on free memory signals.
Jamal S.: cautious: adaptive TTL helps but may mask underlying leak. Do it as short-term mitigation only. mark as P2.
Patrick H.: I'll instrument cost estimator to show cost delta vs TTL changes so product owners can see impact.
Ingrid L.: Ops note: set a conservative pod limit and node eviction earlier to avoid whole-host OOM cascade. link: https://k8s.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/
Maria R.: Ownership + tickets recap: Alex -> INF-2353 (profiling + jemalloc), Jamal -> INF-2354 (GC experiments + repro PR), Ingrid -> INF-2352 (alerts + runbook), Patrick -> INF-2355 (docs + cost calc). target dates in first comment of each ticket.
Alex T.: I'll add an example snapshot upload script to INF-2353:
```bash
# capture heap and upload
pgrep runtime | xargs -I {} gcore -o /tmp/heap.{} {}
s3cmd put /tmp/heap.* s3://redwood-debug/INF-2353/
```
Ingrid L.: Also adding a short Canary gating rule: if canary memory growth rate > baseline * 1.2 over 6h -> hold rollout and trigger SEV2.
Maria R.: Recurring pattern analysis: we've had 4 similar OOM-ish incidents in the last 9 months with small variations (KV pressure, large batch inferences, fragmentation). add that to the RCA: likely combined effect of increasing request tails + new large-sequence workloads.
Jamal S.: Suggest we add a regression check in CI that runs a small memory-pressure scenario against models that touch large-sequence paths. failure -> block merge.
Patrick H.: Good call. I'll scope a small harness and add to devex repo.
Alex T.: blockers? I need access to the production jemalloc metrics; can someone grant read-only to `alex-team`?
Ingrid L.: Done — granted to alex-team for the next 30 days.
Maria R.: Any objections to the cadence? otherwise I'll publish the postmortem follow-up board and assign calendar invites for the weekly check-ins.
Patrick H.: :+1:
Jamal S.: :thumbsup: will post the repro PR link by EOD.
Alex T.: uploading initial heap-snapshots now to INF-2353.
Maria R.: Thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem page with the owners + tickets and close this thread once first weekly check-in is scheduled.
